content:
UMG, roughly 1,200 stores, and the Magento build that won an award and then quietly drained away.

In this issue

  • The Wall. One clarification before the next part. The managed Magento hosting of that era was built on PlatformSH, the platform-as-a-service vendor underneath it.
  • What We Built. Magento Order Management was the spine. One OMS bound every store back to a single source of truth across hundreds of separate Magento instances.
  • The Peak, And The Turn. By the end of 2019 we had launched more than 200 stores in a single year and won the award for the most stores launched.
  • The Slow Drain. The end did not arrive as a decision. It arrived as a drain.
